narr: Showers and thunderstorms affected northeast Tennessee and southwest Virginia during the afternoon and evening hours of August 2nd. Areas from Claiborne county, southeast through Greene and Cocke counties were affected the most. Some reports of flooding were received from Claiborne and Cocke counties.
ev: Water across Interstate 40 and Hartford Rd.
Several roadways in northeastern Claiborne county overflowed with water.
lsr: Water across interstate 75 and Hartford Rd.
